Andrew.

I'm good.

Yeah.

Out of where?
Sorry, Fleet.
Fleet in the uk.
In the uk yeah, yeah, yeah, of course, yeah, yeah.

Sorry?

Yeah, US.
Okay.

bluetuskpartners.
bluetuskpartners.
Okay.

Okay.

Okay.

I mean our preference would be the east coast and in D.C. would be ideal, but we don't want to rule out anything in the US Anything.
But I mean if you'll really get my attention, if it's something in the D.C. metro area and then if it's not there, then east coast would be the preference.
If not that, it would be central and if not that mountain and if not that west.
Okay.
As east is east most.
But you just want to make your life easy basically.
So preferably on the as easy as possible.

So at Memory Blue we had offices in all Four time zones in the US So we're familiar with kind of working with operators across the entire country.
Okay, cool.
So what is BlueTower?

Yeah, it's essentially just a holding company that we want to make our acquisitions through.
Okay, so that's the holding company for the group.
Yep.
Okay, brilliant.
And what's the size of the company that you've acquired already?
We haven't made any acquisitions yet.
Oh, okay.
So the bluetuskpartners is completely separate.
bluetuskpartners was part of Memory Blue.
Memory Blue made the acquisition.
Got you.
Okay, so this is a fresh.
That's right.
Okay, brilliant.
All right, and what's your timeline for this?

Okay, so.
So, I mean, quite a few of our clients are like you in that they will start fairly broad and then narrow down as we go.
So is that kind of what you're looking for?
You want to taste all the sweets in the sweet shop?
That's right.
See what's out there and then kind of narrow it as we go.
Right?
Yeah, but I mean, we're not looking at roofing companies or anything like that?
No, no, no, of course not.
I think we're somewhat niched in terms of what we're looking for and in.

Not.
Well, that's gonna be dependent upon the seller.
Okay.

It's going to be mostly dependent upon the seller.
Okay.
So pretty flexible.
Very flexible.
And I'm sure you're really experienced in this, but usually it's the buyer that kind of drives the deal structure and puts the offer on the table.

When we sold our business, we had no idea what we were Doing.
Yeah.

He's.

One.

Yeah.
Okay, cool.

Okay, cool.

Okay, great.
Okay, cool.

Absolutely.

So one and a half percent of enterprise value.
Yeah.

I see.

Okay.
Yeah.

Okay.

I know that there's outliers.

Okay.

So.
Sure.
Okay.
Yeah, I would say it's about, it's probably a six month process.

I see, I see, Gotcha.

Yeah, I see.
Okay, gotcha.
Okay.

Yes.
Yeah.
Okay.

I see.
Interesting.
Interesting.

Okay.

Andy.

I mean we can dig into what it is exactly want around that and professional services, but, but there's plenty out there.
I mean we, like I said we, we've done some HubSpot searches before.
It was actually in Germany.
Okay, well, it's in Europe.

Okay, what about, what about the size there?
That, that 500 to 5 million?

US yeah.

Perfect.

summary.overview:
- Collaboration potential identified between Chris Corcoran, Justin, and Mark based on past working relationships, enhancing trust for future engagements.
- Capitala specializes in M&A advisory for marketing agencies with services covering buy side, sell side, and marketplace platforms.
- The founders have a strong background, growing a company founded in 2002 to 700 employees and successfully executing a major equity sale.
- Acquisition targets are focused on adjacent B2B go-to-market services, seeking firms with $500k-$5 million adjusted EBITDA in the U.S.
- Geographic focus is primarily on the U.S. East Coast and D.C. area, though they are open to opportunities nationwide, including Seattle.
- BlueTower is the holding company established for acquisitions, although no deals have been made yet.
- Urgency noted for initiating search immediately, understanding that M&A processes may take months to complete.
- Sourcing strategy will start broad with a plan to refine targets over time, showing flexibility in stake acquisition and control levels.
- Deal structures are adaptable based on seller motivations, with a willingness to incorporate earnouts and seller notes.
- Monthly fee of $5,000 plus 1.5% success fee based on closed deals aligns payment with deal disbursement, emphasizing a performance-based approach.
summary.short_summary: The conversation revolved around a strategic plan to acquire a majority stake in a US go-to-market company, targeting those with adjusted EBITDA between $500,000 and $5 million. Chris Corcoran and Mark emphasized flexibility in deal structure and founder involvement, with a preference for companies in professional services or tech-enabled sectors, particularly around platforms like HubSpot or Clay. Geographically, they aim for the East Coast, especially the D.C. metro area, but remain open to nationwide opportunities. The acquisition process will be facilitated by BlueTower, their holding company, and managed through Capitala, which will assist in sourcing and vetting potential deals. The team aims to leverage their previous experience in scaling businesses to replicate growth and ensure long-term success.
